title: Laumufarþegi Worker component diagram
description: The Worker at icelander.net/games/laumufarthegi: routes the page, a small API and each room's WebSocket, checks icelander.net's sign-in only to start a room, and runs one Room Durable Object per room, which holds the room's state in its storage, applies every action through the shared rules and sends each player their own view.

components.name: Laumufarþegi Worker
components.responsibility: Everything that runs on Cloudflare for the game.

components.name: Routes (index.ts)
components.responsibility: Redirects the bare path to BASE/; answers api/me (may this visitor start a room, and where to sign in), api/rooms (start a room: sign-in unless HOST_SIGN_IN is none, same origin only, a fresh random code, retried on a clash) and api/rooms/CODE/ws (a valid code, a WebSocket upgrade, this site's origin, passed to the room); serves every other GET from the static assets with the HTML uncached; a thrown error becomes a JSON 500. Exports Room.

components.name: Room Durable Object (room.ts)
components.responsibility: One per room code: /create makes the room once; /ws accepts a hibernatable WebSocket. Each socket's first message joins (a token takes back a seat, a name takes a new one); every later message is an action applied with act(), after which the state is saved and each open socket gets its player's view. Answers ping with pong, marks a player disconnected when their last socket closes, tells removed players and closes their sockets, runs out timeouts on its alarm, and deletes itself after IDLE_MS (24 h) without a change.

components.name: Shared code
components.responsibility: The rules, the protocol and the topics.

components.name: Browser page
components.responsibility: The built page in dist/, served through the ASSETS binding.

components.name: Sign-in (vendor/icelander-auth)
components.responsibility: The shared library: createAuth (currentUser, hasRole, signInPath) and sameOrigin.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who holds the site_session cookie, and their games: roles (service binding ACCOUNTS).

components.name: Durable Object storage and alarm
components.responsibility: Each Room's own SQLite-backed storage (one key, state), its single alarm, and the runtime's hibernatable WebSockets with their attachments.

relationships.description: The Durable Object class, bound as ROOMS.
ROOMS.get(ROOMS.idFromName(code)).fetch: POST /create, a 409 meaning the code is taken; /ws with the browser's upgrade request.
AUTH.currentUser and AUTH.hasRole (games:play) in mayHost; signInPath for the answer; sameOrigin before starting a room.
BASE, CODE_LETTERS, CODE_LENGTH, isCode and CreatedRoom.
ASSETS.fetch for every path outside api/.
newRoom, addPlayer, byToken, setConnected, act, tick and view from game.ts; isCode and the message types from protocol.ts; TOPICS.
storage.get and put of state, setAlarm for the next deadline or the idle clean-up, deleteAll; acceptWebSocket, getWebSockets and serializeAttachment for the player id on each socket.
Asks who holds the session cookie.
